calibration_notes.method: manual mat corner correspondences, solvePnP; dimensions estimated
calibration_notes.object_motion: Initial/final from top image; frames 168..213 inferred from TCP and release interpolation. Kinematic reconstruction, contact physics not validated.

wrist_fit.limitation: manual approximate landmarks and estimated dimensions, not a measured intrinsic calibration

measurements.source: Dimensions reported directly by the user on 2026-11-06

cube.material: wood (reported by user); species and density unknown

measurements.integration_status: New runs use confirmed dimensions; historical simulation settings remain frozen with their original dimensions.

robot.gripper: standard SO-101; no finger extension or replacement (user confirmed)
robot.base_support: robot rests directly on tabletop (user confirmed)
robot.gripper_native_zero: Inner fingertip surfaces touch with no cube when commanded native gripper=0 (user confirmed 2026-11-06)

mat.source: User confirmed 40.5 x 40.5 cm and 2mm thickness on 2026-11-06

wrist_camera.objective: distal jaw orange masks only; geometric zero fixed from user closure constraint; red cube excluded

limitations: Current follower calibration identity with historical recording is unverified.
Shared motor parameters fitted to native recorded states; no real hardware validation.
Camera intrinsic distortion and exposure timestamps unmeasured; whole-frame delays approximate fitted image timing.
Wood mass, friction and bowl wall/floor thickness remain estimates; bottom outer diameter98mm is user measured.
Initial cube pose derived from RGB silhouette; occlusion and pixel boundaries produce uncertainty.
Original native action values and recording boundaries retained; no action repair, future-state following, cube weld/forces/teleportation.
This refinement uses all72 native-state and terminal-image observations for shared calibration; results are calibration-set replay, not independent policy or hardware validation.
Terminal red-pixel centroid approximates cube projection and can differ from cube center under occlusion; episodes9/53 detections excluded.
Identified motor Coulomb friction includes effective gearbox/controller behavior and is not an independently measured coefficient.

metric_camera_identification.source: User measured 405mm square mat; four visible corner-line intersections; pinhole with fixed principal point and no distortion
metric_camera_identification.caveat: Four approximate pixel correspondences; intrinsic distortion remains unmeasured

base_support_identification.source: User confirmed no riser; standard base mesh lowest vertex -2.4mm below model base frame

onset_geometry_identification.source: independently reviewed first moving-jaw contact; original initial RGB cube pose; no bilateral stall fit
limitations: First-contact image brackets uncertain by 1-2 frames
Prior approach pushes cannot be completely excluded

motor_identification.objective: native joint-state soft-L1 error; free/empty gripper only; no task outcome reward

camera_timing_note: Whole-frame causal observation delay rounded from image fits; no command retiming. Fits are estimates, not measured hardware timestamps.
model_archive: self-contained per-episode XML with one shared copy of source mesh assets

initial_reference_clearance_identificati.method: minimum-norm shared joint reference correction under all72 initial-pose collision constraints; no action or per-frame corrections
initial_reference_clearance_identificati.caveat: Model reference adjustment within calibration uncertainty; source collision approximations are not measured geometry

material_identification.objective: recorded held-gripper state error plus0.1weighted native arm error; not final bowl outcome
material_identification.caveat: Estimated contact parameters; not independent material measurements

contact_response_identification.source: original action prefixes through release; observed held-gripper state and arm state errors
contact_response_identification.objective: native gripper softL1 +simulated first-grasp jaw/cube surface gap +0.1arm capped MSE +reference priors +initial collision penalty; no final object outcome reward

gripper_zero_user_constraint: Empty fingertips must touch at native command 0; +4 mm empty gap alternative (-8 deg) is rejected.

gripper_zero_identification.source: User confirms native zero is fully closed; source distal collision surfaces define geometric contact; first-frame state is NOT assumed to be zero
gripper_zero_identification.method: Root of minimum distal jaw separation in unchanged source geometry
limitations: Model collision surfaces approximate physical surfaces
User supplied zero-contact constraint, not a measured angular reference
Actuator deadband and finger compliance remain uncertain

native_motor_refinement.objective: 80%per-episode native softL1 plus20%stable held-state error for arms; free/empty gripper only; no object outcome reward
native_motor_refinement.held_selector: stable blocked observations, no minimum opening25 requirement

stable_grasp_identification.objective: stable real blocked-gripper softL1 plus physical gap at stable hold plus0.1arm error; no final outcome reward
stable_grasp_identification.held_selector: stable blocked gripper, no opening25 threshold

stable_material_identification.objective: native stable held-gripper softL1 plus0.1arm cappedMSE; no final outcome reward

full_dataset_identification.objective: all72 native stable grasp-state error plus physical grasp gap and observed terminal cube image error; mean plus0.25worst-quartile loss; calibration-set result, not heldout generalization
full_dataset_identification.held_selector: stable blocked gripper, no opening25 threshold

wrist_camera_validation.scope: jaw-only image calibration on measured joints; not integrated-state validation, not a blind task-generalization split
jaw-only image calibration on measured joints; not integrated-state validation, not a blind task-generalization split

worst_grasp_identification.objective: mean stable held-gripper softL1 plus worst8 mean plus0.5armMSE; optional simulated bilateral contact-gap term at real hold onset; all72 calibration set
